commonRules.emptyDenominator: null, with numerator and denominator retained
commonRules.unknownValue: null plus missingness/evidence reason; never zero
commonRules.moneyUnit: USD with cost scope and evidence provenance
commonRules.independence: Sequence/block-aware by default; Wilson intervals only with justified independent Bernoulli trials
commonRules.reportStatus: offline_report computes a metric from normalized evidence (evidence-schema.mjs); it is not collected or observed live

metrics.population: All independently offered due reporting opportunities at the declared horizon
metrics.definition: (Verified public-reader-confirmed publications + explicit quiet completions) / due opportunities; separate quiet, rejected, failed and unresolved outcomes
metrics.evidence: Offered manifest, durable request outcomes, publication/source identity and public-reader evidence

metrics.population: Due opportunities with fully observed W + deadline
metrics.definition: Established successes no later than W + deadline / mature opportunities; retain immature/future counts and whole-due-cohort bounds
metrics.evidence: Independent due manifest, trusted success boundary, observation cutoff and preregistered deadline

metrics.population: All due reporting opportunities
metrics.definition: Known terminal outcomes / due opportunities; failure or safe rejection is resolution, not delivery success
metrics.evidence: Request and publication outcomes with terminal evidence

metrics.population: All persisted publication candidates
metrics.definition: Candidates with matching public-reader evidence / persisted candidates
metrics.evidence: Edition/source IDs, publication status and exact public-reader response/probe bounds

metrics.population: All offered approved canonical acquisition jobs
metrics.definition: Exact readable accepted content / offered jobs; attempts separate and no source-recall claim
metrics.evidence: Source approvals, jobs, acquisition results, evidence receipts and quality/provenance

metrics.population: Eligible edition × subscription-version units observed for the full delivery horizon
metrics.definition: Units with durable push-service-acceptance receipts / eligible offered units; actual coalesced network sends counted separately
metrics.evidence: Eligibility/cutoff/ownership snapshot and browser_push_receipts

metrics.population: Canonical jobs exposed to each declared controlled fault
metrics.definition: Jobs reaching their intended outcome within recovery horizon / exposed jobs; safe refusal and unknown financial outcomes distinguished
metrics.evidence: Fault plan, attempts, canonical identities, recovery outcomes and accounting

metrics.population: All rows eligible for the named metric
metrics.definition: Rows with trustworthy required identities/timestamps / all eligible rows; omissions stay in the cohort
metrics.evidence: Collector validation diagnostics and eligible manifest

metrics.population: Successfully public-reader-confirmed reporting opportunities
metrics.definition: U - W; conditional latency distribution accompanied by all due failures/censored/missing counts and polling bounds
metrics.evidence: Original window cutoff and independent positive/negative reader probes

metrics.population: Acquisition attempts with observed start and extraction/response completion
metrics.definition: R - A; legacy acquiredAt is not extraction completion
metrics.evidence: Prospective monotonic request/extraction observations

metrics.population: Actually cited evidence revisions with trusted availability/publication observations
metrics.definition: U - E; explicitly selection-conditioned and not a completeness metric
metrics.evidence: Availability observation or labelled historical decision proxy, cited revision and reader probes

metrics.population: Eligible edition/subscription units accepted by the push service
metrics.definition: N - P; recorded publication proxy labelled when commit is unobserved; not device receipt
metrics.evidence: Publication boundary/proxy and post-response push acceptance receipt

metrics.population: Consenting instrumented client subscriptions
metrics.definition: V - P with clock uncertainty; unavailable without authorized client telemetry
metrics.evidence: Client receipt/display observation and publication boundary

metrics.population: Valid completed observations for one explicitly named latency/stratum
metrics.definition: R7 p50/p95 with n, coverage and failure/censoring counts; never average p95s or silently filter invalid observations
metrics.evidence: Underlying validated timing sample and full eligible denominator

metrics.population: Fixed arrival and observation intervals
metrics.definition: Offered, actually dispatched, completed, successful and not-started counts / real elapsed interval; attempts separate
metrics.evidence: Independent offered schedule, driver and queue/job events

metrics.population: Outstanding due canonical jobs/windows at each sample
metrics.definition: Backlog, peak, oldest due age and job-seconds area; sample gaps not treated as zero; financial unknowns separate
metrics.evidence: Due manifest and timestamped canonical state samples

metrics.population: Pre-fault cohort plus separately tracked ongoing offered arrivals
metrics.definition: Restoration until cohort clear for declared stability interval; unresolved accounting reported separately
metrics.evidence: Fault/restoration boundary, cohort states and follow-up samples

metrics.population: Canonical billing operations attributed once to this run
metrics.definition: Deduplicate agreeing final operation snapshots; separate reported cost, ledger settlement, unknown cost, reserved ceilings and unsettled exposure
metrics.evidence: Existing account/connector ledgers and bound provider receipts; no estimates as actuals

metrics.population: All attributable run costs including failures/retries, with successful-publication denominator
metrics.definition: Fully known acquisition + inference + allocated infrastructure cost / verified public briefings; null if denominator or required cost coverage is missing
metrics.evidence: Reconciled canonical operations, predeclared shared-cost allocation and infrastructure cost evidence

metrics.population: Attributed provider operations only; excludes infrastructure and unallocated/shared amounts
metrics.definition: Fully reported provider-operation cost / verified publications; unknown charges or zero denominator make full ratio null
metrics.evidence: Final canonical operation snapshots and verified-publication count

metrics.population: Canonical attributed provider operations
metrics.definition: Ledger-settled operations / all attributed operations; provider reporting alone does not count as ledger settlement
metrics.evidence: Ledger settlement state and canonical billing IDs

metrics.population: All offered opportunities and actual canonical model calls
metrics.definition: New billed calls, tokens and repairs with retries, failures and reuse distinguished; missing tokens remain unknown
metrics.evidence: Actual provider receipts joined once to original operation identities

metrics.population: All offered work and resulting publications/accounting/notifications
metrics.definition: Duplicate publication/payment identity, wrong source, lost evidence/history, changed dates/windows, revoked-source publication or unsafe push; never hidden in an average
metrics.evidence: Canonical identities, immutable artifacts and controlled recovery assertions

metrics.population: Observed setup, operation and recovery tasks
metrics.definition: Measured active human time and intervention count; elapsed unattended time or estimated reading time is not effort
metrics.evidence: Consented task observation with actor, start/stop and intervention records

metrics.population: Exact frozen input/output hashes reviewed separately by language
metrics.definition: Human-assessed accuracy, relevance, importance, completeness, repetition and novelty; absence of labels is unavailable, not pass
metrics.evidence: Person 1 independent annotations, rubric, provenance and reviewer agreement
